timely.label: 20 Years Ago
timely.line: Twenty years ago this week, in 2006, Taylor Swift released her debut album, the record that made her a rising star in country music.

timely.label: Reba's Back
timely.line: Reba McEntire's NBC sitcom Happy's Place, where she runs the Tennessee tavern she inherited from her dad, returns for season three on Friday night.

timely.label: Family Movie
timely.line: Wildwood, a fantasy film based on an acclaimed children's novel about a girl saving her baby brother in a secret enchanted forest, stars Mahershala Ali and Angela Bassett.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: The Missouri Department of Conservation is asking Central Missouri deer hunters to get their deer tested for chronic wasting disease all season, at MDC offices, meat processors, taxidermists and freezer head drops.

johnsons.label: Outdoors
johnsons.line: Researchers sank 140 fallen and cut trees into a 92-acre Wisconsin lake, and fish production in that lake doubled.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: A Reddit poster's frugal Halloween tip: a four-pound bag of bulk saltwater taffy costs about ten dollars and holds roughly 300 pieces of candy.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: One tester ranked the most affordable new electric cars of 2026, and the Tesla Model 3 came out on top under $40,000, with the Nissan Leaf and Kia EV3 close behind.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Starbucks has new Halloween treats out now, including a Black Cat Frappuccino and a $15 Bearista charm, while the $30 glow-in-the-dark cold cup is the splurge.

johnsons.label: Life
johnsons.line: Netflix's November lineup includes the drama series The Altruists, the thriller Heartland starring Jessica Chastain, and an NFL game on Thanksgiving Eve.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Budget Bytes says the secret to juicy baked chicken breasts is soaking them in a simple brine before you season them and bake them until golden.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Skinnytaste rounded up 13 easy weeknight meatloaf recipes, including turkey meatloaf, meatloaf with brown gravy, cheesy stuffed meatloaf, air fryer meatloaf and mini meatloaves.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: A warm fall breakfast bowl of creamy coconut quinoa, roasted sweet potato, blueberries, pecans and coconut whipped cream tastes almost like dessert, according to Skinnytaste.

johnsons.label: Cooking
johnsons.line: Lay's has a new limited-edition potato chip flavor that tastes just like Thanksgiving dinner, out more than a month before the holiday.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad says his 3-year-old has gotten into Paw Patrol and he can't take it, because Bluey tells real stories with soul while Paw Patrol is so generic.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit dad who does bedtime every night says he daydreams about those moments in the middle of meetings, and tells other parents they're doing the best they can.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: A Reddit mom says the internet is full of parents acting superior, and reminds everyone that a kid with a snotty nose does not make you a bad parent.

johnsons.label: Family
johnsons.line: An only-child mom writes that a one-and-done family isn't a lesser family, and that parents of just one child deserve to feel stressed too.
